local_changes.purpose: Atomically set _O_NOINHERIT together with _O_BINARY before both _wopen and fallback open, preventing unrelated Windows children from inheriting HDF5 file handles.

Watch the complete ext/hdf5 source/configuration tree for native rebuild invalidation. Four inherited layout chunks in this already-modified file were formatted with the installed rustfmt; non-whitespace bytes are unchanged from the reviewed candidate.

change_scope: Only the two named upstream files are modified; 814 original members are byte-exact. Static/zlib features and all other dependency versions are retained.

evidence.observation: Parent HDF5 closed; rename failed with OS32 while child alive, succeeded after child reaped. This demonstrates the mechanism, not a direct trace of every earlier failure.

limitations: Patched native rebuild and repeat probe are pending at source staging.
HDF5_DIR must be absent for the locked bundled-static route.
Preserve the full bundled LICENSE and source notices with distribution.
